facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's booklet for fiscal year 2023-2024 says the Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system supplies data on births, deaths and causes of death, reports birth registration completeness of 90.04% and death registration of 41.8% through it, and tabulates from the CRVS database 15,270 deaths registered in 2023 by type of health facility (8,872 at district hospitals, 735 at health centres, 2 at health posts); it does not say how or where the record is entered.
